case: Murphy v. United Parcel Service, Inc.
form: One signed lead after plenary review: five-Justice actual-disability vacatur, six-Justice regarded-as affirmance, and nine-Justice perceived-class framework and Supreme Court nonreach. Stevens concurs with Breyer; Stone concurs in part and dissents from P5; O’Connor concurs in P4/P5/P6 and dissents from actual-disability vacatur with Scalia, Kennedy and Thomas.
form_legal_basis: Distinct component coalitions require severable portions within one lead; a common author joins each. No part is divided to affect author counts.

governing_propositions.I: P1/P3 underlying impairment without beneficial mitigation; individualized proof, statutory construction and vacatur for reassessment. Five direct joins; no separate P2 holding.
governing_propositions.II-A: P4 perceived-class-of-jobs framework only, no P5 application. Nine direct compatible joins.
governing_propositions.II-B: P5 insufficient breadth/perception proof on this record. Six direct joins.
governing_propositions.III: P6 Supreme nondecision of qualification/DOT defenses and their separation from coverage. Nine direct joins to nonreach and limits; necessary preserved issues remain below after actual-disability vacatur.
governing_propositions.IV: Affirm in part and vacate in part: actual-disability vacatur and remand, five votes; regarded-as affirmance, six votes.
governing_propositions.Stevens_Breyer: Join P1/P3 actual-disability vacatur, P4/P6, and no P5 application. D1 persuasive guidance; D2 individualized reassessment without a final disability finding.
governing_propositions.Stone: Join P1/P3 actual-disability vacatur and P4/P6. Dissent from P5: any preserved regarded-as theory should be resolved on its elements, with necessary qualification/safety/accommodation questions on remand; no automatic award or waiver.

assignment.assigning_justice: Stone-Zsela for actual disability; O'Connor for regarded-as coverage
assignment.pool_explanation: The Chief assigns the actual-disability component from Stone-Zsela, Stevens, Souter, Ginsburg and Breyer; minimum 12, ceiling 13. O’Connor assigns P5. A single author must join both components; Souter and Ginsburg constitute the common eligible pool, minimum 12 and ceiling 13.
assignment.basis: Both assigners choose Ginsburg for her independent W3 perceived-occupation conclusion rejecting the motive shortcut, T2/F3 no-finding vacatur on the unreconciled regimen and material residual evidence, Bragdon continuing-impairment concurrence and X-Citement Video scope analysis. Souter is the strongest alternative; Ginsburg’s independent support for P5 supplies the closer fit. Counts play no part in the choice.
